primary_endpoint: Reduction of at least one fibrosis stage without worsening of MASH at week 36.
efficacy_outcome: At week 36, the endpoint occurred in 18% with efruxifermin 28 mg versus 13% with placebo (adjusted difference 3 percentage points; 95% CI, −11 to 17; P=0.62) and in 19% with 50 mg versus 13% with placebo (difference 4 percentage points; 95% CI, −10 to 18; P=0.52).
safety_signal: Gastrointestinal adverse events were more common with efruxifermin; most were mild or moderate.
